tasting_notes: Hungarian herbal bitter from over 40 herbs and spices, aged in oak; bittersweet, complex digestif unchanged since 1790.
Unicum matured with dried plums (debut 2012, relaunched 2019); the bitterness softened by fruit-forward plum sweetness.
Double-matured in oak then former Tokaji wine barrels for six months; honey and dried-fruit notes alongside herbal bitterness.
Arabica-coffee twist on the herbal base (introduced 2020); roasted coffee over the bittersweet Unicum profile.
Lighter, sweeter, citrus-forward adaptation launched 2003 for export markets, with reduced bitterness.
Zwack pear spirit-drink (the sweetened, flavoured non-pálinka SKU) with added pear flavouring and honey.
